name: Name
formatTip: zip opens on every system without an extra program. tar.zst is the fastest and keeps rights and owners. 7z packs the smallest. rar needs the rar program on the server.
levelTip: Photos, videos and music are packed already and hardly get smaller. For them “None” saves time.
passwordTip: zip, 7z and rar encrypt with AES-256. tar.zst has no password.
takenTip: A file with this name is there already. It stays, the new archive gets a number.
about: About {size}, runs as a job in the background
own: Into a folder of its own
ownTip: Makes a folder named after each archive, so nothing mixes with the files there.
clashTip: Keep both adds a number to the new name. Replace overwrites the file that is there.
unpackPasswordTip: At least one archive is encrypted. Without its password it cannot be unpacked.
yields: Makes {size}, runs as a job in the background
pickArchives: Pick one or more archives first, such as ZIP, 7z, RAR or TAR
everyMember: Every file in the archive is read, nothing is unpacked
stayRed: Damaged archives stay marked red in the list
lockedTip: The archive is encrypted. Unpacking asks for the password.
inArchive: Nothing can be packed from inside an archive
